captions.detailed: A countertop bread maker appliance with a metallic grey/stainless steel body and a hollow baking chamber inside. The top features a hinged lid with a transparent blue glass window and a small, rectangular ingredient trap door. On the front, a recessed black control panel houses two rotating black dials and a green push-button start switch. The main lid pivots upward on a rear hinge, the small ingredient door rotates on its own hinge, the internal kneading spindle rotates continuously at the bottom of the chamber, and both control dials spin continuously.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a countertop bread maker. The model should include a hollow main body with a front control panel (featuring two rotating dials and a push button), a main hinged lid with a glass viewing window, a small hinged ingredient trap door on the lid, and a rotating kneading spindle inside the chamber. Apply appropriate metallic, glass, and plastic materials to the parts.
captions.factory: The code constructs the bread maker by first modeling a hollow main body using a filleted box and subtracting an inner cavity. A recessed control panel on the front is created via boolean subtraction. The lid is built as a separate frame with a central cutout, containing a glass pane and a small rectangular ingredient door hinged on the frame. Inside the chamber, a central cylinder represents the rotating kneading spindle. The control panel is populated with two small cylinders for continuous-rotation dials and a green cylinder representing a prismatic push button. Articulations are defined for the main lid hinge, the ingredient door hinge, the spinning spindle, the two rotating dials, and the push button.
